name: _IsFortranContiguous
reason: FortranContiguousExact is an iff against the closed form (len 0; NULL strides with ndim <= 1 or at most one dimension > 1; else stride = itemsize*prod(shape[:i]) for every dimension > 1) under the shape/strides-length invariant, so an always-true or always-false test fails it; matches _testbuffer.is_contiguous on 20k random views and NULL-stride re-exports.

name: _IsCContiguous
reason: CContiguousExact is an iff against the closed form (len 0, NULL strides, or stride = itemsize*prod(shape[i+1:]) for every dimension > 1), walking from ndim-1 down as :516-523 does; an always-true test fails it; no mismatch on 3.15.2.

name: PyBuffer_IsContiguous

name: _Py_add_one_to_index_F
reason: AddOneFExact: for an in-range index the result is in range and its first-digit-fastest mixed-radix value is the old one plus one modulo prod(shape); an in-range representation is unique, so every digit is determined and a zero-everything function fails it.

name: _Py_add_one_to_index_C
reason: AddOneCExact unfolds addOneC and pins the last-digit-fastest value plus one modulo prod(shape) with the result in range, which determines every digit.
